decision_rationale: The abstract presents scVision as a new foundation model for single-cell biology on transcriptome images. It does not describe a substantive text/language component in the candidate model.
evidence_snippet: "renders each cell as a continuous image"; "pretrain a vision transformer"; "adapted from language models" refers to prior models, not scVision

decision_rationale: The abstract describes a new vision-language foundation model for single-cell microscopy. It explicitly uses image-text pairs and text-guided cross-modal alignment.
evidence_snippet: "vision-language foundation model"; "text-guided cross-modal alignment"; "pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs"

decision_rationale: This is a class-aware multi-modal target prioritization framework that uses an external Evo2 model as one evidence stream. The abstract does not describe a new text-bio foundational model.
evidence_snippet: "integrates five distinct evidence streams"; "conditional log-likelihood scoring using the Evo2 genomic foundation model"

decision_rationale: SPgen is a new multi-modal foundation-model framework for spatial protein prediction. The abstract mentions biological modalities and protein sequences, but not a substantive text/language component.
evidence_snippet: "proteome-wide spatial protein prediction"; "integrates protein sequences, functional annotations, transcriptomic profiles, and spatial information"

decision_rationale: The abstract introduces ECO and LSCP as a new AI-native formal language/latent-space framework, but it does not clearly center a biological data modality. It does, however, connect biological knowledge representations to large language models.
evidence_snippet: "maps ECO graphs into the residual stream of large language models"; "controlled simulations"; no clear biological data modality

decision_rationale: LLMBDC is a training-free framework that uses zero-shot semantic reasoning of LLMs to cluster GO terms. That is an application layer over an existing language model rather than a new text-bio foundational model.
evidence_snippet: "training-free framework"; "leverages zero-shot semantic reasoning of LLMs"; "cluster GO terms"

decision_rationale: MOSANIC learns from spatial transcriptomics but initializes nodes with frozen foundation-model representations such as ESM-2 and ChemBERTa. The text-related pieces are side inputs rather than a substantive text-bio model bridge.
evidence_snippet: "initialises every node with a frozen foundation-model representation (scVI, ESM-2 and ChemBERTa)"; "learns a tissue’s communication network directly from spatial transcriptomics"

decision_rationale: The abstract explicitly says this paper is a review summarizing AI-driven multi-omics approaches for breast cancer. It is not a primary candidate model paper.
evidence_snippet: "This review aims to summarize recent developments"; "We have also highlighted the integration of omics-based data"
